approvalStatement: The product owner approves the commercial model/license direction for the LivePortrait+MuseTalk talking-head avatar lane, subject to the conditions recorded here.
scope: PowerPoint-native narration recording with embedded LivePortrait+MuseTalk talking-head media, YuNet detection, MediaPipe jaw parsing, BetterPPTX-owned deterministic detail enhancement, and SAM2 matting
conditions: This is an owner product decision and risk acceptance; it is not a representation of external legal counsel or a change to an upstream license.
The exact worker source revisions, model revisions, weight hashes, image digest, notices, and SBOM must remain pinned and reviewable.

The legacy InsightFace detector, BiSeNet face parser, ResNet18 parser checkpoints, CodeFormer, and RVM must remain absent from the resale-safe worker image; the frozen replacements are pinned OpenCV Zoo YuNet, the Apache-2.0 MediaPipe Face Landmarker mask adapter, the BetterPPTX-owned deterministic detail enhancer, and pinned Apache-2.0 SAM2. MuseTalk's upstream README states that its trained model is available for any purpose, including commercial use.
Upstream test data remains excluded from the product and customer paths.
Native 3D Meshy/Mixamo/presenter-asset licensing is a separate representation and is not approved by this record.
Public/customer enablement remains disabled until the separate billing reconciliation and identity-quality gates pass; this record closes licensing for the exact frozen worker image.
